## Instagram Integration (lightweight handler)
Verifies Meta webhook, resolves `instagramAccountId → chatbotId`, handles **Message Echoes** (`is_echo: true`) without AI reply, upserts **ChatSession**, calls **Core AI Brain**, then sends reply via IG Graph API.

### Setup
1. Open **Execute Core AI Brain** and select the imported *Core-AI-Brain* workflow.
2. Verify Token: `driplare_n8n_instagram_secret_2026`.
3. Integration.config holds `instagramAccountId`, `connectionSource`, and either
   `instagramAccessToken` (instagram_login) or `pageId` + `pageAccessToken` (facebook_login).
4. **Is Message Echo** guard filters out messages sent by merchant from Meta Business Suite and logs them directly to DB without triggering AI.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  c."chatbotId",
  i."connected",
  i."status",
  i.config->>'connectionSource' AS "connectionSource",
  i.config->>'pageId' AS "pageId",
  i.config->>'pageAccessToken' AS "pageAccessToken",
  i.config->>'instagramAccessToken' AS "instagramAccessToken",
  i.config->>'instagramAccountId' AS "instagramAccountId"
FROM "Integration" i
JOIN "Chatbot" c ON i."chatbotId" = c."chatbotId"
WHERE i.platform = 'instagram'
  AND i."connected" = true
  AND i.config->>'instagramAccountId' = '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.instagramAccountId }}'
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO "ChatMessage" ("id", "chatbotId", "sessionId", "userId", "role", "sentByHuman", "content", "mediaUrl", "mediaType", "timestamp")
VALUES (
  'cm_' || md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text),
  '{{ $('Fetch Integration').item.json.chatbotId }}',
  '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.sessionId }}',
  (SELECT "userId" FROM "Chatbot" WHERE "chatbotId" = '{{ $('Fetch Integration').item.json.chatbotId }}' LIMIT 1),
  'assistant',
  true,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.userMessage }}', ''),
    '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaUrl }}',
    CASE WHEN '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}' = 'image' THEN '[Image]' ELSE '[Audio]' END
  ),
  NULLIF('{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaUrl }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}', 'text'),
  NOW()
);

UPDATE "ChatSession"
SET
  "lastMessage" = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}' = 'image' THEN '📷 Sent an image'
    WHEN '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}' = 'audio' THEN '🎵 Sent an audio'
    ELSE '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.userMessage }}'
  END,
  "isActive" = false,
  "updatedAt" = NOW()
WHERE
  "chatbotId" = '{{ $('Fetch Integration').item.json.chatbotId }}'
  AND "sessionId" = '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.sessionId }}';

INSERT INTO "ChatSession" ("id", "chatbotId", "sessionId", "platform", "guestName", "profilePhoto", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
VALUES (
  'cs_' || md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text),
  '{{ $json._upsert.chatbotId }}',
  '{{ $json._upsert.sessionId }}',
  'instagram',
  '{{ $json._upsert.guestName }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json._upsert.profilePhoto }}', ''),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT ("chatbotId", "sessionId")
DO UPDATE SET
  "guestName"    = EXCLUDED."guestName",
  "profilePhoto" = COALESCE(EXCLUDED."profilePhoto", "ChatSession"."profilePhoto"),
  "updatedAt"    = NOW();

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "recipient": { "id": {{ JSON.stringify($('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.senderId) }} }, "message": { "text": {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Core AI Brain').item.json.replyText) }} } }
